goal.decided: Once overnight is released, its users, a person or an AI, get their queued Claude Code tasks done in the hours nobody answers, through the usage limit, instead of spending the daytime limit on them: in the evening they queue tasks to start at a set time, and in the morning they read which tasks finished and which were given up, and merge the results from their main session.

deliverables.name: This design tree holds every deliverable that releasing overnight needs, each after what it stands on
overnight's developers know whom overnight serves, and what its users do with it once it holds

decisions.decided: a person, or an AI such as another plugin's orchestrator, who has Claude Code tasks to run while nobody answers
the user sets how many tasks run at once

deliverables.name: A person or an AI decides from the README alone whether overnight fits their work, and queues their first night's tasks
overnight's developers build its parts so that together they give what its README promises

decisions.about: How the limit's handling is checked
decisions.decided: by integration cases alone, whose double of claude -p gives the limit reply as a real run recorded it, and whose clock is the test's own; no run on the real usage limit

deliverables.name: overnight's developers see, before anyone writes a body, whether its parts fit together as its architecture draws
overnight's developers see, before anyone builds a part, whether its parts joined as its architecture draws give each key result
Each part of overnight does what its architecture gives it, as each of its unit cases passes
overnight's parts joined give each key result, as each integration case passes
overnight's skill does what its users ask, as each of its unit cases passes on the model its users run; dropped where the architecture's test strategy gives overnight no prompt
Users install overnight from ccpm's marketplace at its first release

decisions.decided: claude plugin validate --strict passes for overnight and the marketplace; the marketplace and the root README list overnight at the version of its plugin.json, its CHANGELOG gives the release's line, and check.sh passes with every case of dev/overnight/tests

deliverables.name: rn's developers get as issues the vital few of what the user met in rn while overnight was made, each traced to its cause in rn

decisions.decided: Once overnight is released, each event below is sorted by its cause in rn; only the causes without which rn's users fail to reach their aim become issues of rn, each naming its events, once the user says yes; an event an open issue already holds goes to that issue

decisions.about: Event: the goal put with no lead-in
decisions.decided: After /rn:on and 'issue #62', rn put the goal, the languages, and the issues at once with no word of what it asked or why; the user: 'いきなりすぎて意味不明です', and the design tree and rn's steps are of no interest to the user

decisions.about: Event: the plan put as names alone
decisions.decided: rn put the plan for sign-off as a list of deliverables' names; the user: 'what is made toward the goal, how the work goes, and why that way is good' should be proposed

decisions.about: Event: a plan with a gap
decisions.decided: rn's plan went from the test design straight to the release, with no build; the user: '５テスト設計で６リリース？'

decisions.about: Event: test levels left out of the plan
decisions.decided: rn's plan named no integration test, leaving each test level to the build; the user: 'インテグレーションテストは不要なの？テスト戦略で不要になったら省けばいいのでは？'

decisions.about: Event: points settled before their inputs
decisions.decided: Before any product vision or architecture, rn put how many tasks run at once, the parts' names, and the limit's logic, taken from the issue's text, and proposed a real night's run as a test that rests on hitting the limit; the user: 'こんなに一気に計画を立てるの？まだ設計もアーキテクチャも作ってないのに？設計ツリーのBP見てるの？'

decisions.about: Event: English quoted to a Japanese user
decisions.decided: rn quoted the best practice in English in a Japanese conversation; the user: '英語分からん'

decisions.about: Event: the worktree apart from herdr
decisions.decided: rn made the run's worktree by git worktree add inside herdr, so herdr showed no workspace for it; opened by herdr worktree open, it shows in agents only after a restart; issue #74 holds the herdr part
rn's commands carry disable-model-invocation: true, so an AI that the user asks to take a piece of work, such as another Claude Code, can't run it through rn
